text:
deploy-bot: Canary failed for payments-service chart promotion in eu-west-1. Observed: 5/10 pods CrashLoopBackOff, events show 'serviceaccount payments-sa not found' and rolebinding refused. Auto-suggested action: pin release to v2.1.4 in eu-west-1 and abort promotion. See deploy log: https://deploy.internal/reports/3720001122 :rotating_light:

alex: ugh, saw alerts. Is this the new chart that added a new SA name?

maya: yes, chart v2.2.0 introduced payments-sa (used by sidecar). Previously we used payments-main-sa. Chart author forgot the migration RoleBinding.

sam: can we hotpatch the rolebinding instead of rolling back? quickfix patch possible?

deploy-bot: Manual patch recommended if promoter approves. Warning: patch bypasses release immutability; track in release notes.

jordan: what's the blast radius of a patch? we have 8 clusters, only eu-west-1 affected right now (canary).

alex: only canary pool in eu-west-1 saw the new image. staging & prod not promoted.

maya: hotpatch command i tested: ```kubectl -n payments create serviceaccount payments-sa || true
kubectl -n payments create clusterrolebinding payments-sa-binding --clusterrole=payments-role --serviceaccount=payments:payments-sa || kubectl -n payments delete rolebinding payments-main-binding; kubectl -n payments create rolebinding payments-sa-binding --role=payments-role --serviceaccount=payments:payments-sa``` That got pods running for me in a dev cluster.

sam: neat. Is that safe for prod later? we need to preserve least privilege, the clusterrolebinding is broad. prefer namespace RoleBinding.

maya: agreed. I used namespace rolebinding in the snippet (second attempt). clusterrolebinding fallback only if legacy role doesn't exist.

release-manager: decision needed: pin canary to v2.1.4 (safe, quick) or hotpatch (fast restore but manual state). We also need to update release notes & open a bug for chart author.

jordan: leaning pin. Keeps audit clean and we can cut a v2.2.1 with RBAC fix. What do others think?

alex: pin+patch in parallel? pin the promotion now, then apply a scoped namespace RoleBinding as a temporary measure to reduce regressions while chart fix goes out.

sam: pin first. then a constrained rolebinding if release owner requests. We should avoid clusterrolebinding.

release-manager: plan: 1) pin eu-west-1 promotion to v2.1.4 now (rollback/pin window opens). 2) create an issue and assign to @maya to produce v2.2.1 with RBAC migration notes. 3) if immediate prod impact emerges, we'll run the namespace rolebinding hotpatch with approvals. 4) document hotpatch steps and add to release notes.

deploy-bot: Actioning: pin applied to eu-west-1 for payments-service (promotion aborted). Rollback job id: rb-3720001122. Notifying release channel.

maya: opening PR for v2.2.1 with changelog and migration snippet. Will include helm values note: set legacyServiceAccount: true to retain payments-main-sa mapping during rollout.

jordan: add a brief line to changelog about why promotion was paused (RBAC mismatch) so ops teams aren't surprised.

alex: thumbs up. Can someone add the rollback blurb to release-notes draft? I'll tag in docs.

release-manager: I'll update release-notes and schedule a follow-up sync at 14:00 UTC to confirm v2.2.1 readiness. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
